==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Known for killing [[Faker]] for First Blood as {{ci|Janna}} at [[2015 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2015]].
* Played in all of the first three [[Mid-Season Invitational|Mid-Season Invitationals]] from 2015 to 2017, the only non-[[SKT]] player to do so.
